onchain.title: On-chain settlement
onchain.desc: Fills settle on Solana against collateralized YES/NO token supply.

instant.title: Off-chain matching
instant.desc: A central limit order book matches orders, then the program settles each fill.

noncustodial.title: Non-custodial
noncustodial.desc: You keep control of your keys. Orders and redemptions require your wallet signature.

oracle.title: Optimistic oracle
oracle.desc: Someone proposes an outcome with a bond. Others can dispute it before finalization.

categories.title: Market categories
categories.subtitle: Intended coverage once markets are live.

custody.definition: You do. Your wallet signs orders; collateral sits in the market vault on-chain. SolsMarket does not hold withdrawal keys for your balance.

resolution.definition: An outcome is proposed with a bond and remains open to challenge for a set window. After that window, the winning side redeems 1:1 for collateral.

fees.definition: The production fee schedule is not published yet. It will appear in the protocol docs before public trading.

notCasino.term: How is this different from a casino bet?
notCasino.definition: You hold a tradable position priced by the book. You can sell before resolution; you are not locked into a single payout path until the market settles.

chain.term: Which chain does it run on?
chain.definition: Solana only. Matching is off-chain; fills settle on-chain through the program.

q1.a: A prediction market protocol on Solana for trading collateralized YES/NO tokens on real-world events.

q2.a: Yes. Orders and redemptions require your wallet signature; SolsMarket does not take custody of your funds.

q3.a: An off-chain order book matches trades; each fill settles on-chain. Resolution uses an optimistic oracle.

q4.a: After resolution, winning tokens redeem 1:1 for collateral into your wallet.

q5.a: Fees will be documented before public trading. There is no separate custody or withdrawal lock-up fee by design.

one.title: Connect a wallet
one.desc: Use a Solana wallet. Actions that move funds require an explicit signature.
one.shot: A screenshot of the Connect wallet dialog: continue with Google, sign in by email, or pick Phantom from the browser wallets.

two.title: Buy YES or NO
two.desc: Choose a market and buy the outcome at the price you accept.

three.title: Redeem after resolution
three.desc: When the market resolves, winning tokens redeem 1:1 for collateral.
three.shot: A screenshot of a resolved market: Yes won, paying out $40.32 USDC on 40.32 Yes shares, already in the wallet.
